# 118. SPECIAL: "Vd:n ska inte bli ordförande" – Latours vd om svackan och framgångsformeln

**Feed**: borssurr  
**Published**: 2026-08-25  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Special interview episode with Latour CEO Johan Hjertonsson focusing on the investment company's strategy, its shift toward wholly-owned industrial holdings, and its de-rating from premium to discount over the past two years. The hosts probe whether the market undervalues Latour's underlying operations (13% order growth, ~30bn SEK owned industrial revenue) while the CEO stresses long-term company-building over short-term multiple games. Broader themes: building/construction cyclicality, data-center exposure, security, and capital allocation between listed and unlisted assets.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 LATO-B — Latour | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Trades ~194-195 vs stated substance ~203-204 with conservative own valuations; underlying holdings growing (13% order growth). Premium turned to discount.

#### Reasoning

Hosts argue market underprices Latour's wholly-owned industrials, which Latour values conservatively; underlying earnings/revenue rising and ~40% of substance only accessible via the Latour share. Premium-to-discount swing seen as cyclical. Aktiedoggen said 'avvakta', and CEO won't comment on discount, so conviction is moderate for patient long-term holders.

#### Sell Triggers

- if underlying wholly-owned industrial earnings turn negative
- if construction/building exposure deteriorates further
- if discount stays wide with no operational improvement

> *"Här har du någonstans 40% av vårt substansvärde som du inte får exponering på, om du inte köper Latour-aktien."*

---

### 🟢 ASSA-B — Assa Abloy | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

One of world's finest, dominant in its niche, strong earnings growth and lower valuation than historically. Latour kept 93% after a small 7% trim.

#### Reasoning

Chairman and major owner describes Assa Abloy as fantastic with a bright future and a fine profit trajectory at a lower multiple than before; retaining 93% signals conviction. Only a marginal stake was sold for portfolio allocation, not a negative view.

#### Sell Triggers

- if organic growth stalls
- if acquisition engine falters
- if security/building end-markets weaken

> *"Assa Abloy är ett av världens finaste bolag och dominerande i sin bransch och har en fantastiskt fin vinstutveckling med lite lägre värdering än vad de har haft tidigare."*

---

### 🟢 TOM — Tomra | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Very strong Q2 ('raketrapport'); deposit-system rollouts in Poland, UK, Spain, Portugal (France later) drive reverse-vending; food fixed, recycling cyclically down but set to recover.

#### Reasoning

Latour chairman argues the weak share price diverges from operations: reverse-vending benefits from multi-country deposit-scheme rollouts, food division turned around after management change, recycling is cyclically depressed but historically rebounds. Structural growth plus a very strong quarter support upside.

#### Sell Triggers

- if deposit-system rollouts are delayed
- if recycling downturn deepens without cost offset
- if food division problems recur

> *"Nu såg du ju Tomras Q2 resultat, det var ju väldigt starkt, ett av de starkaste kvartalen faktiskt."*

---

### 🟡 FAG — Fagerhult | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Latour largest owner (~just under 50%), very building-exposed, hit by Covid and downturn, share slaughtered; strong board and management, CEO convinced of recovery.

#### Reasoning

Former Fagerhult CEO and current major owner acknowledges the painful share decline but stresses a strong board/management and clear path out of the building-cycle trough; Latour is keeping its stake, signalling patient hold rather than add or exit.

#### Sell Triggers

- if construction demand stays depressed
- if margins fail to recover in next cyclical upturn
- if management execution weakens

> *"Vi är långsiktiga och enträgna och jag är helt övertygad om att Fagerhult kommer ta sig ur det här."*

---

### 🟢 ALIG — Alimak | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Building-exposed but coped fantastically through the downturn; CEO Olle Jönhag highlighted as an excellent VD.

#### Reasoning

Latour's former chairman praises Alimak's resilient development despite heavy construction exposure and singles out CEO Olle Jönhag as a proven operator worth backing, implying continued confidence in the company.

#### Sell Triggers

- if construction end-markets deteriorate
- if CEO/management changes
- if margins compress

> *"Jag var till alldeles nyligen också ordförande i Alimak som också har en fantastiskt fin utveckling."*
